ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a coordinate graph; the vertical axis is labeled "per capita income (yuan)", with values from 0 to 5000; the horizontal axis is labeled "percentage of the population engaged in manufacturing in the total population". Point B in the figure is located in the lower left, indicating that region B has relatively low per capita income and a relatively small proportion of the population engaged in manufacturing; point A is located in the upper right, indicating that region A has relatively high per capita income and a relatively large proportion of the population engaged in manufacturing. There is a connecting line between points A and B, reflecting differences in manufacturing development and income levels between regions. Then reason: Region A has developed manufacturing and high income, which may promote the transfer of part of manufacturing to region B, where income is relatively low and labor costs are relatively low. Similar industrial sectors transferred into region B often have greater advantages in capital, technology, management, or scale, and will form direct competition with the original similar industrial sectors in region B. Therefore, similar industrial sectors in region B will suffer a serious impact.

method.method_draft: 先读图：纵轴是人均收入，横轴是从事制造业人口占总人口百分比；A点位于右上方，表示人均收入高、制造业人口比重大，B点位于左下方，表示人均收入低、制造业人口比重小。再读题：题目问这种现象会对B地区“同类工业部门”造成什么不利影响。推理桥梁：A地区制造业发达且收入高，劳动力成本上升，相关制造业可能向收入较低的B地区转移；但转入企业通常资本、技术、管理和规模更强，会直接压迫B地区原有同类工业部门。因此可答：B地区同类工业部门会受到严重冲击。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是一个坐标图，纵轴标注为“人均收入（元）”，数值从0到5000；横轴标注为“从事制造业的人口占总人口的百分比”。图中B点位于左下方，表示B地区人均收入较低、从事制造业人口占比较小；A点位于右上方，表示A地区人均收入较高、从事制造业人口占比较大。A、B两点之间有连线，体现地区间制造业发展和收入水平差异。再推理：A地区制造业发达且收入高，可能推动部分制造业向收入较低、劳动力成本较低的B地区转移。转入B地区的同类工业部门往往在资本、技术、管理或规模方面更有优势，会与B地区原有同类工业部门形成直接竞争。因此，B地区同类工业部门会受到严重冲击。
